title: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ephtal, reincarnated from modern Earth into a magic world, spends a whole life failing to master magic and dies in anguish. Reborn again 400 years later with his knowledge intact, he finds magic has declined so far that his once-mediocre skill now makes him the strongest mage, and he sets out for the peak of magic, including at a magic school (Wikipedia; Manga Up!/Comikey blurbs via MU and AniList).
life_message: Persistent effort is eventually rewarded, and a second chance should be used to fulfil an old dream.
